channel.title: Shinro — Writing
channel.description: Field notes from Shinro on robot control infrastructure: compiled policy kernels, in-process supervision, and live module replacement.

item.title: Change a walking robot's software without stopping it
item.author: noreply@shinro.dev (Shinro)
item.description: Swap a Microduck's navigator, then its walking brain, while it walks. The software never restarts and the duck never stops; the same two brains on Pollen Robotics' own runtime put the duck on the floor. Reproduce it in about two minutes, no robot needed.

item.title: Name it, then move it
item.author: noreply@shinro.dev (Shinro)
item.description: Four clicks hand a live LeKiwi from a script to a learned policy: the console names the session and host before motion, Cake holds the capability, and the SmolVLA policy runs beside both.
